morphology.pattern_note: 词根以双唇浊塞音 b 起首，meN- 取 mem- 形式；词根的 b 保留，词尾 ng 表示 /ŋ/。

senses.zh_definition: 牵着某人的手引路或扶着其行走。
senses.en_definition: To lead someone by the hand.
senses.ms_definition: Memegang tangan seseorang untuk memandu atau memimpinnya berjalan.
senses.nuances: 强调身体上的牵引和陪同行走，不能把所有一般性的带路都机械译成 membimbing。依据：[DBP：bimbing](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=bimbing)。

collocations.en: lead a child across the road by the hand

collocations.ms: membimbing warga emas ke tempat duduk
collocations.en: guide an elderly person to a seat

senses.zh_definition: 通过讲解、示范、培养或持续协助，指导某人学习、发展或采取正确行动。
senses.en_definition: To guide, mentor, or train someone through instruction and support.
senses.ms_definition: Memberikan petunjuk, asuhan, penjelasan atau latihan kepada seseorang.
senses.nuances: 用于教育、职场培训及道德引导，常带循序帮助的意味；不等于只下达指令，也不必然表示专业心理咨询。依据：[DBP：bimbing](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=bimbing)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pegawai kanan ditugaskan untuk membimbing pekerja baharu dalam penyediaan laporan kewangan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 资深职员受委派指导新员工编制财务报告。
dual_scenarios.en: Senior officers have been assigned to guide new employees in preparing financial reports.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kak Lina yang membimbing aku masa mula-mula kerja kat sini dulu.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Kak Lina yang membimbing saya ketika saya mula bekerja di sini dahulu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我刚来这里上班时，就是 Lina 姐带我的。
dual_scenarios.en: Kak Lina was the one who showed me the ropes when I first started working here.
spoken_features: aku 是熟人之间的第一人称代词。
masa 在这里相当于标准语的 ketika。
kat 是 di 的口语形式；Kak 是对年长女性的亲切称呼。

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Siapa yang membimbing kau masa mula-mula kerja kat sini?
messages.ms_standard: Siapakah yang membimbing kamu ketika kamu mula bekerja di sini?
messages.zh: 你刚来这里上班时，是谁带你的？
messages.en: Who showed you the ropes when you first started here?

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Kak Lina. Dia ajar satu-satu je, jadi aku tak rasa susah sangat.
messages.ms_standard: Kak Lina. Dia mengajar saya satu demi satu, jadi saya tidak berasa terlalu sukar.
messages.zh: Lina 姐。她一步一步教，所以我没觉得特别难。
messages.en: Kak Lina. She took me through everything step by step, so it didn't feel too difficult.

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries preserve a vivid connection between physical and figurative guidance in bimbing: taking someone by the hand and helping someone understand. Membimbing expresses the action, while bimbingan names the guidance and pembimbing the guide. This connection offers a cultural image of teaching as accompaniment. It illustrates the recorded meanings without claiming a documented chronology between them.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bimbing 想成牵着人一步一步前进：先是牵手引路，再是带着学习；mem- 把这个动作变成 membimbing。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 在师生、导师与学员之间使用自然且正面。向资深同事求指导可说 Mohon bimbingan daripada tuan/puan，以体现尊重。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 用于工作辅导时，强调协助成长较为得体；对平辈直接宣称自己要 membimbing 对方，可能显得居高临下。身体引导前宜先询问对方是否需要帮助。
